content: Poldi Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede hogok nadisukilitidok yenindidimeguk
Notneye, nu Bepaŋ’walaŋ yodakale mede hanimbene wooŋ hidut hatigut nai uŋaniŋ nadisu-fuliŋgoŋ mede eŋ hanihohoket mu tugut.
Be mede noli yodok nemu tiulidokooŋ ugut. Nu adi hidut hatiŋa Jesu Kilisto koloŋdabek foloŋ uliŋit adi’walaŋ mede hogok haniŋdok nadifafaŋeŋ ugut.
Nu hidut hatiŋila gweheyeŋgoŋ, eŋ muntamuntayeŋgoŋ, tiŋa heheleŋgoŋ hatigut.
Nadisu-fuliŋgoŋ mede be mede yogaligalike mu tiŋa Mede Momooŋ yohautagut. Nu adi hidi Bepaŋ’walaŋ saŋiniŋ u kaŋ nadisukilitineŋ yoŋa adi’walaŋ Munabuli diniŋ saŋiniŋ foloŋ yohautagut.
Tiyauge hidi meeniŋ’walaŋ nadisu-fuliŋgoŋ mede foloŋ nadisukilitineeneŋ doktiŋa unduŋ tugut.
Poldi Bepaŋ’walaŋ nadihebet yobihikuk

Bepaŋ’walaŋ nadisu-fuliŋgoŋ diniŋ mede adi me Bepaŋ’walaŋ talii fafaŋeŋ takalitauyeŋ mehinek tiiŋ adi heki adi kedem yeniyam. Tiŋa undugoŋ kwetfoloŋ me’walaŋ nadisu-fuliŋgoŋ diniŋ mede be me talitimeŋ kwetfoloŋ iŋoŋ liweneeŋdi mede yoiŋ, indi wendok tuwot mu yoyam. Mokoŋ.
Indi adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ mede fuliŋ eŋ hebiniŋ u yohautayam. Mede woŋ adi me indi minta walandaaŋ adi’walaŋ hauta gineŋ hatidok Bepaŋdi koomkwaha nehogok nainit mokit tububihila hatiŋila yoyout tuguk.
Me loloŋhinit hatigiŋ adi’walaaniŋ nebek niŋdi mede hebiniŋ u mu nadidakalegiŋ. Nadidakalene tigiŋ binek adi hauta Molom koloŋdabek foloŋ tuwot mu utne tigiŋ.
Wendok Youkudip Mede niŋ indiŋ hatak,

content.text: “Bepaŋdi me welesiloŋ timiiŋ hekidok nemek momooŋ tiulidokoguk u nebek niŋ
be me nadisuŋiŋ gineŋ nemu nadisuguk.”

content: Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mebi ninimbihitak

Mede unduŋ u biyagoŋ hatak iŋgoŋ oŋ, indi yadi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabuliŋiŋ niŋkulune mede u ninimbihikuk. Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli wendi nemenemek hogohogok wendiniŋ mebi fuliŋgoŋ hinek nadilak. Eŋ Bepaŋ ne’walaŋ mebi fuliŋmamaŋ hinek hatak u wanaŋ nadilak.

Me nediyeŋ noliŋiŋ’walaŋ weleŋ diniŋ mebi nadiwek? Me weleŋ molom nehogok nadilak. Undugoŋ hinek nebek niŋdi Bepaŋ’walaŋ weleŋ diniŋ mebi u tuwot mu nadiwek. Ne’walaŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi hogok nadilak.
Kaŋ indi kwetfoloŋ me diniŋ munabuli mu moŋgokumun. Indi adi Bepaŋ’walaŋ welesiloŋ diniŋ mebi nadidok tiŋa Bepaŋ’walaaniŋ Munabuli u moŋgokumun.

Indi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ wendegoŋ mede kahat tihamam. Woŋ adi me nadisu-fuliŋgoŋhinitdi mu nininihitubu-didimegiŋ, woŋ adi Uŋgoniŋ Munabulidi nininihitubu-didimeguk. Unduŋ doktiŋa Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli diniŋ mede adi Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli’walaŋ maŋiŋ mede tagimneeŋ yoyam.

Me Uŋgoniŋ Munabulihinit mokitdi Bepaŋ’walaŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli diniŋ mede u tuwot mu nadineŋ. Adi u dediŋ tiŋa nadineŋ? Moŋ hinek. Adi u nadiune mede kauleŋ tibek. Woŋ adi me Uŋgoniŋ Munabulihinitdi hogok nadidok tilak.
Me Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli fotokoyembune hatiiŋdi nemek hogohogok u kedem nadidakaleneeŋ. Iŋgoŋ me Uŋgoniŋ Munabulihinit mokitdi wendok mebi mu nadidakaleneeŋ.
Wendok Youkudip Mededi indiŋ yolak,

content.text: “Wapum’walaŋ nadinadi u nediyeŋdi nadilak ale kedem nindidimewek?”

content: U biyagoŋ, iŋgoŋ Munabulidi nihitubu-lodaune Kilisto’walaŋ nadinadi kedem nadidakale-hinakayam.
